data.value: Will the McCain and Obama campaigns both publicly confirm their candidates' participation in the first 2008 presidential debate at the University of Mississippi before the scheduled debate day?

The first presidential debate of the 2008 election is scheduled for September 26, 2008, at the University of Mississippi, organized by the Commission on Presidential Debates. As of September 1, 2008, neither campaign has publicly confirmed their candidate's participation. Both campaigns have been in discussions about debate terms, but no final public confirmation has been issued. The debate is expected to proceed unless a campaign withdraws or fails to confirm.
